query:
SELECT rp.id, rp.name, rp.type 
FROM raw_products rp 
LEFT JOIN raw_product_molecules rpm ON rp.id = rpm.raw_product_id 
WHERE rpm.raw_product_id IS NULL 
ORDER BY rp.type, rp.name 
LIMIT 50;
